blocks.prompt: 11 In how many ways can a hockey team of 11 players be selected out of 15 players? how many of them will include a particular player?
blocks.explanation:
Ek sawal mein do sawal hain: pehle saari teams, phir woh teams jin mein ek khaas player zaroor ho.
Team selection hai: players kis tarteeb se chune gaye, is se team nahi badalti.
Plan: \({}^{15}C_{11}\); phir khaas player ko pehle team mein daal kar baqi 14 mein se 10 chunein: \({}^{14}C_{10}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 15 players; 11 ki team.
Humein find karna hai: (1) kul kitni teams; (2) kitni teams mein ek khaas player shamil hai.
Tareeqa: combinations, aur \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\) se hisaab chhota karenge.

Part 1: saari teams
\[{}^{15}C_{11} = {}^{15}C_{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{15 \cdot 14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12}{4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{32760}{24} = 1365\]
Kyun: 11 players khilana aur 4 players bahar bithana ek hi faisla hai. 11 factors ki jagah sirf 4 factors ka hisaab karna para.

Part 2: khaas player team mein hai
\[\text{places left} = 10,\ \text{players left} = 14\]
\[{}^{14}C_{10} = {}^{14}C_{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{14 \cdot 13 \cdot 12 \cdot 11}{24}\]
\[= \dfrac{24024}{24} = 1001\]
Kyun: Woh player pehle hi team mein hai, is liye us ki seat aur woh khud dono ginti se nikal gaye: 10 seats, 14 players.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{15}C_{10}\) likhna aam ghalti hai; khaas player ko players ki list se bhi nikalna hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{without him} = {}^{14}C_{11} = {}^{14}C_{3} = 364\]
\[1001 + 364 = 1365 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har team mein ya to woh player hai ya nahi. Dono qism ki teams jama karein to kul teams milni chahiye, aur 1365 hi mila.
blocks.final_answer: Kul 1365 teams; in mein se 1001 mein khaas player shamil hai
